title: Gallop metric registry entry
description: One line of the JSONL metric registry. A metric is promotable only when every required field is filled in and `status` is trusted; the gaming field is mandatory because a metric nobody has thought about gaming is a metric that will be. A provisional entry carries `provisional_reason`, which is what makes the registry the floor's backlog and not just its inventory.

name.description: Snake-case metric name, the key the prior store uses

definition.description: The computation, precisely enough to reimplement

source.description: Source of truth: the table or model the number comes from

unit_of_analysis.description: What one observation is: user, session, order, day

gaming.description: How this metric gets gamed, stated before it happens

status.description: Only trusted metrics carry a readout

provisional_reason.description: Why a provisional metric is not trusted yet: blocked (the promotion work cannot be done now) or deferred (it could be and has not been ranked). Set it whenever a question runs on the metric under the provisional exit

promotion_blocker.description: The unmet promotion-checklist item, by number, and for blocked, who owns closing it
